role: The tameable sit toggle: while the isSitting flag holds, a tamed wolf or ocelot stops moving and sits; the flag is set externally (right-click) through setSitting.
scope_reason: Only EntityTameable (wolf, ocelot) registers this task (grep over oracle/src), and world.conf forces wolves = off and ocelots = off, so it is never constructed, in the oracle too (SPEC 'Unsupported features are world switches').

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: tamed, dry, on the ground, and either ownerless or the owner is far/attacking
